items.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: We did, the trumpet kings, in the studio, and then he did it again in Montreux. He had Clark Terry, Dizzy, right, and Roy,

ctx.x: You know, went absolutely crazy. Seventeen thousand of them, you know?

We did, the trumpet kings, in the studio, and then he did it again in Montreux. He had Clark Terry, Dizzy, right, and Roy, and Basie’s remarks that night, he was on the bill that night and Basie’s remark that night before we came out was, “okay now the trumpets are up next,” and Basie was sitting in a chair, you know how he’d sort of sit and overlook the whole situation, but he says [smacks his lips] “somebody’s gonna get hurt tonight.” He said, “somebody’s gonna get it.”
But it made music, and some of the most exciting things that ever were played, and everybody was excited about it.
